multisolo.rules: Seed 0 · Vanilla spawn · Survival · Normal difficulty
multisolo.consent: Enabling sends your network identity, preset sign content and sign positions to the relay. Nearby signs are fetched every 10 seconds. No network when disabled.
multisolo.error.endpoint: Invalid address or preferences could not be saved. Use HTTPS (HTTP only on localhost).
multisolo.error.profile: For this alpha, create the experience with only Fabric and Multisolo.
multisolo.error.world: Enable messages in a compatible Connected Solitude solo experience.
multisolo.error.relay: Relay unavailable or request refused. Your world stays offline; your draft is preserved.
multisolo.error.create: Creation failed. Check the log; no existing save was converted.
multisolo.error.sign: Place a sign nearby in this experience.
multisolo.vote.saved: Vote saved. Click again to undo.
